guidebookFieldsToMerge.title: A little more Đà Lạt
guidebookFieldsToMerge.body: Begin at Đà Lạt Market or the paths around Xuân Hương Lake. Explore Vạn Thành’s flowers and Domaine de Marie, or plan a day farther afield at Langbiang and Tuyền Lâm Lake. Follow the destination links for current visiting details, then return to a quiet evening in the garden.

photosPolicy: Leave current guidebook.photos unchanged; no new photographs or asset references proposed.

placesToAppend.d: Explore stalls of local produce, flowers, preserves and regional food in the city’s central market area. The surrounding evening market is another way to experience Đà Lạt’s food culture.
placesToAppend.addr: Chợ Đà Lạt, Nguyễn Thị Minh Khai, Đà Lạt, Lâm Đồng, Việt Nam

placesToAppend.d: Follow the lakeside paths for a gentle walk, a pause by the water or a glimpse of daily life in the city centre.
placesToAppend.addr: Hồ Xuân Hương, Trần Quốc Toản, Đà Lạt, Lâm Đồng, Việt Nam

placesToAppend.d: Visit this distinctive church and convent on Mai Anh Hill for a quieter cultural stop and a look at Đà Lạt’s architectural heritage. Respect worship and check visitor access before going.
placesToAppend.addr: Nhà thờ Domaine de Marie, 1 Ngô Quyền, Đà Lạt, Lâm Đồng, Việt Nam

placesToAppend.d: Discover a flower-growing district known for roses and other blooms. Visitor access and seasonal displays vary; confirm the current visiting area before setting out.
placesToAppend.addr: Làng hoa Vạn Thành, 43 Vạn Thành, Đà Lạt, Lâm Đồng, Việt Nam

placesToAppend.d: A pine-fringed lake landscape for a slower outing beyond the city centre. Choose a confirmed visitor access point or arrange activities with a current local operator.
placesToAppend.addr: Hồ Tuyền Lâm, Đà Lạt, Lâm Đồng, Việt Nam

placesToAppend.d: A highland outing north of Đà Lạt with mountain scenery and hiking possibilities. Confirm the current access route, conditions and any guided activity directly before visiting.
placesToAppend.addr: Khu du lịch Langbiang, Lạc Dương, Lâm Đồng, Việt Nam
